reply.text: Leave 2026-11-23, arrive 2026-11-27: 5 days and 3.34 km/s in burns.

approximations: Around Earth the orbits are taken as circular and in one plane, and any departure day works: where a moon is along its orbit is not modelled.

The NRHO is approximate: it is taken as a plain lunar ellipse entered or left in one burn. NASA's planned route uses a lunar flyby, about 450 m/s after trans-lunar injection, so this burn is likely low.

to.name: Near-rectilinear halo orbit (NRHO), taken as a 1,000 by 70,000 km lunar ellipse

orbit.name: Near-rectilinear halo orbit (NRHO), taken as a 1,000 by 70,000 km lunar ellipse

notes: Any departure day works for a trip around one planet, so it leaves on the earliest day asked for.
